identity.provenance_of_these_numbers: HAND-AUTHORED, measured by comparing the file's key set against the script that claims to write it. The script writes rates, peaks and measured_on.machine; this file has none of the three. The file has measured_on.runner and measured_on.note; the script writes neither, at 1d1b767 or at 234150e or today. Nothing else in the repository writes this path. So the file was not produced by --update. That does NOT establish that no run ever happened -- a person may have run the script, read the numbers it printed, and typed them in with a note explaining the desktop-versus-runner incident. What it establishes is the narrower and sufficient claim: no run in this repository produced this file, so its 19,312 rec/s and 24.4 MiB have no artefact behind them. The note and the runner field are a careful, correct account of where the numbers came from, and they are still an account rather than a measurement.
